schemas.notes: Shared by CLI evidence list and read-only MCP hadara.evidence.list.
Documents read-only MCP memory-mode context export; CLI export-context remains file-writing.
Documents CLI/MCP capability discovery, availability metadata, and disabled surfaces.
Documents read-only active-run projection with degraded warnings for local mutable state.
Documents read-only resume guidance; it does not mutate active-run state or resume a process.
Documents private portable-store manifest records without private raw content or source paths.
Documents advisory and strict release gate reports.
Documents structured HADARA event records used by private audit JSONL and future debug/read surfaces.
Documents provider adapter configuration references without storing provider secret values.
Documents provider call summary reports without prompt, response, or secret content.
Documents read-only CLI write-boundary preflight reports for expected project/portable write paths.
Documents dry-run installer planning reports before any install mutation implementation.
Documents reduced package-smoke reports before dry-run or executable package-smoke command implementation.
Documents reduced read-only major feature smoke reports for core service/read-model validation; installed binary and launcher checks are deferred.
Documents reduced executable source-checkout smoke reports for disposable clean checkout validation.
Documents reduced release artifact build reports for tarball, checksum, manifest, and package-content verification without publish or GitHub Release mutation.
Documents read-only final release dry-run reports that cross-check public evidence artifacts and planned release targets without publish or GitHub Release mutation.
Documents approval-gated publish/deploy readiness reports with token presence checks but no token values or release mutation.
Documents reduced public smoke evidence summaries attached by package-smoke and clean-checkout smoke execution.
Documents generated release artifact manifest files for tarball hash and package file lists without publish or GitHub Release mutation.
